meta.name: The Undateables
meta.description:
A man who doesn't believe in love crosses paths with a hopeless romantic while helping others find love – but will something blossom between them?

Not complete. On your server: S1 16/32 (missing E17-32)

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Seon Hui offers Yook Ryong to date her on a condition. Joon Soo starts to fall for Jeong Eum. Eun Nim goes on a trip by herself. Hoon Nam makes Doo Ri meet So Wool again, and Doo Ri feels for So Wool.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Hoon Nam and Jeong Eum are locked in So Wool's house, and they get to know each other better there. Jeong Eum finds the car keys. Joon Soo finds out that Jeong Eum did not come home last night and feels upset.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Hoon Nam gets close to Jeong Eum to flirt with her while Joon Soo tries to protect her from Hoon Nam. Hoon Nam and Jeong Eum have a kiss. Seung Ryul collapses suddenly, and Joon Soo discovers him.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Jeong Eum feels complicated as Susie turns up before Hoon Nam. Joon Soo admits his feelings for Jeong Eum. Joon Soo decides to confess his feelings for Jeong Eum, and Jeong Eum tries to avoid him, feeling bad for him.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Hoon Nam, Jeong Eum, and Joon Soo start to live together. Joon Soo learns that Hoon Nam is dating Jeong Eum. Jeong Eum is an eyesore to Susie as she likes Hoon Nam. Joon Soo and Susie run into Jeong Eum and Hoon Nam.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Jeong Eum breaks up with Hoon Nam after finding out about the bet, and Joon Soo stays next to Jeong Eum. Hoon Nam struggles with heartache after breaking up with Jeong Eum and realizes how much he loves her.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: It's still painful for Hoon Nam that Jeong Eum is gone. He tries various ways to get back with her. Jeong Eum is shocked after finding out who the ghost client is. Seon Hui misses Yook Ryong.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Jeong Eum makes up her mind to trust Hoon Nam once again and spends some good time with him alone. Susie and Joon Soo have to see each other again. Susie asks Jeong Eum to help her find a new date.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Eun Nim learns about the relationship between Hoon Nam and Jeong Eum. Hoon Nam decides to meet Seung Ryul. Ga Yong goes out on a blind date. Hoon Nam does not tell Seung Ryul that he is Jung Do's son.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: An unprecedented tragedy takes place for Hoon Nam and Jeong Eum, who were having a great time together. Jeong Eum wants Hoon Nam to make up with Seung Ryul. Yook Ryong wants to help Seon Hui, who has a hard time.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Jeong Eum now knows Hoon Nam learned about her embarrassing past and gets mad at him for not telling her. Jeong Eum and Hoon Nam succeed in matching another couple. Dol Jin finally finds his true love.

videos.title: The Undateables
videos.overview: Doo Ri and So Wool start to prepare for their wedding, and Hoon Nam and Jeong Eum help them in every way. Jeong Eum is promoted for her great performance. Hoon Nam watches the video Jeong Eum recorded for him.
